title: Stylized Woodcutting Axe
author: Price
modifications: Original geometry/UVs and 1024px diffuse retained; uniform scale, grip centered, +X cutting edge reoriented towards weapon -Z, 30 degree forward lean, mipmaps. Replaces the earlier JamesWhite axe; physical-only VR controls are retained.

author: Drummyfish / tastyfish
title: Oldschool AFPS Weapons — saw sword / FPSloppa chainsaw
modifications: Existing textured chainsaw receiver retained. Blade cut and capped in Blender, forward pneumatic piston, impact plate, mounting lugs, guide rods and ribbed pistol grip added. Local -Z is the strike direction; grip is below the receiver. No old hammer shaft remains.

title: Flamethrower
author: TheJosh
modifications: Original geometry and UVs retained. Uniform scale, -Y source front reoriented to weapon -Z, upright grip and muzzle anchors, original baked diffuse reduced from 2048 to 1024 pixels with mipmaps; assigned only to TF Pyro slot 7 across all weapon rules.

title: Low Poly Stylized Sniper
author: FFMStudios / Fernando Ferreira (zisongbr)
modifications: Uniform scale and orientation to -Z; original geometry, UVs and olive palette retained. Two opaque scope lens caps (20 triangles) removed for the existing runtime VR optic. Original hollow scope, grip and muzzle aligned. Used for UT99 sniper and TF Sniper across all weapon profiles; normal Doom/Quake railgun unchanged.

title: Gatling/Mini Gun
author: Tech Knight
modifications: Original geometry retained; uniform scale, barrel bundle aligned to -Z, pivot centered on barrel axis. Original diffuse node colours converted to Principled metal materials. Replaces only TF and Assault sentry gun; team-coloured mounting base and gameplay retained.
